product.name: MindBridge
product.description: A CBT-based mental health chatbot delivered via iOS and Android mobile apps. The product consists of a content management system (CMS) holding conversational flows in decision-tree format, a platform API for backend logic, mobile apps, and AI algorithms for sentiment analysis and response selection.

must_meet_both: It is included in the released product (not deprecated or unreleased features)
It is a deviation from the intended function of the core product (fails a User Need or Product Requirement)

probability.5: Very High - almost certain to occur

severity.1: Negligible - No injury or health impact to the patient or user.  Inconvenience or temporary discomfort that resolves on its own without any intervention.
severity.2: Minor - Temporary injury or impairment that resolves with minor first aid or minimal medical intervention.  No lasting health effects.
severity.3: Moderate - Injury or impairment requiring professional medical intervention or treatment.  Reversible harm but may involve extended recovery time.
severity.4: Major - Severe injury, permanent impairment, or life-threatening condition requiring significant medical or surgical intervention.  Potential for long-term disability.
severity.5: Critical - Death or irreversible, life-altering injury.  Includes scenarios that could affect multiple patients or users.

risk_levels.low: Score 1-6: Log as complaint, moderate timeline for resolution
risk_levels.medium: Score 7-14: Complaint with option to escalate to CAPA
risk_levels.high: Score 15-25: Required CAPA with defined timeline
